title: Phase personas carry the no-comments rule, so lanes stop adding what the comment campaign removes
summary: Every lane adds doc comments on new functions (cycles 1702, 1703, 1716) while the operator's comment campaign removes comments package by package; the personas still ask for them. Design doc §7.9 G1.
